releases.label: v0.10.0  2026-09-27 (0446be13)
releases.notes:
### Features
* Configurable resolutions
* Hero mana and health should slowly regenerate over time
* Show how much gold the player has, in the bottom right of the UI
* Show level of enemy hero besides health bar
* Some skill shots can be blocked by allies
### Changed
* Besiktaren R can take over enemy heroes and jungle camps
* Increase death timer the longer the game goes
* Increase range on Gamer Dad autoattack
* Make the Stormcaller's Chain Lightning an instant lightning bolt
* Martin Weiner rebalancing

releases.label: v0.9.0  2026-09-25 (3e993069)
releases.notes:
### Features
* In game chat, so the players can chat with each other. Activate it with the "Enter" key.
* Killing dragon gives all allies a buff, called Dragon's Might.
* level up sound
* Local chat bubble
* New hero Besiktaren.
* New hero FöretaGAREN.
* New hero Gamer Dad
* New hero The Dentist
* Recall to base. Press b to teleport you back to base after a few seconds.
* Show mana bar and name of player on hero.
* Special hero interactions
* Stats panel. Press tab to show stats of all players.
* Support pings. Holding alt and clicking on the map, shows a ping to the allies.

releases.label: v0.6.0  2026-09-24 (f6c2112a)
releases.notes:
### Features
* Support reconnect
* Add jungle camps
* a cannon minion joins every third wave
* a golden burst marks every level up
* Add minimap
* Configurable shortkey for auto-target
* Fog of war
* heroes can walk about their spawn pad before the match opens
* shields look like force fields, and rise and break
* show the gold a last hit pays
* Spawn heals, larger click hitbox, prettier fire, attack-move with A
* Support changing unit sizes
* the spawn barrier is a force-field wall like the shields
* WASD alternative movement
### Bug Fixes
* a hit flashes only the health it took, not the whole bar
* A shield ability that breaks because its health reaches zero also breaks its visuals
* **health bar:** pixel perfect UI ticks
* Improve health bar UI
* keep Ctrl+W and other browser shortcuts from exiting game
* **Keybindings:** Bind abilities per control scheme
* slower bolts and a slower rate of fire for ranged minions
* Sync visual shield to its health
### Changed
* move the camera mode button right of the abilities

releases.notes:

* 3D models for heroes, minions, turrents, crystal, shield generator
* ability upgrade UI, hero stats block, buffs, health and mana bars
* Add another hero
* Add Martin hero
* Add Multiplayer Lobby and improve UI
* Animations for walk, idle, attack, abilities
* camera movement
* control settings for auto attack and structure targeting
* hero portrait with respawn timer in the HUD
* More heroes and prettify UI

* round NavMesh obstacles hugging structure bases
* turret base z-fighting before structures spawn
